debugData.name: Coast tyre tracks
debugData.description: The coast's decal set (p310 §3.3): two tireTracks strips of the decalsGround atlas 1.7 m apart, curving across the beach above the waterline, conformed to showcaseCoast by the terrain add-on (devTools/blender/buildShowcaseBlocks.py), in decalsGround_blend tinted toward the sand (showcaseCoastTracks).
